verdict.rationale: Pylon documents itself as a standalone helpdesk with AI agents (Support/Assist/Background Agents) fully embedded, and shows a Salesforce integration that syncs AI-generated conversation summaries to CRM Accounts with account mapping — but this is a one-way summary sync, not full bidirectional ticket sync, and there is no evidence of the agent running inside Zendesk or Intercom at all. Missing for 10: Zendesk integration, Intercom integration, and true two-way ticket/context sync (not just Salesforce summary push) for any named external helpdesk.
